name: Summit AZ - General Plumbing Batch 2 Report 2026-09-03
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-09-03

# Summary
Pre-implementation report for batch 2: the general plumbing city hubs (Tempe, Queen Creek, Phoenix, Scottsdale, Mesa), the parent /plumbing/ and, for overlap, Chandler and the homepage. Files: report `.md` and `.pdf`, page copies `Summit-AZ-General-Batch2-Page-Copies-2026-09-03.md` and `.pdf` (seven draft pages), and `Summit-AZ-General-Batch2-GSC-Queries-2026-09-03.csv` (about 386 page/query rows with intent class).

# Key findings
- These pages carried 16,245 impressions in three months and 3 clicks. Tempe alone had 14,128 impressions over 612 queries at position 25, acting as the whole company's "Tempe plumber" page.
- Tempe was taking emergency demand that belongs to /emergency-plumber-in-tempe/ (2,186 emergency-intent impressions; the emergency page had zero).
- Outside Tempe and Queen Creek the hubs earned almost nothing non-branded. The homepage owned brand and Mesa; /plumbing/ had an H1 of "Plumbing Service in Mesa, Arizona", so three URLs competed for Mesa.
- Mesa and Chandler were word-for-word identical apart from the city name.
- OTTO was injecting risky content: hidden keyword paragraphs (display:none), a hidden "Partners Links" block linking a competing plumber, ten Review schema entries on Tempe, and an H2 rewritten into a phone link.
- Real Summit photos (DSC series) all had empty alt text.

# Page copies
- Seven pages drafted with a shared "Why [City] homeowners choose Summit" block (the four brand pillars). The draft copy included "24/7 emergency line", "bonded" and "financing available", which later rules (Sep 21 to 25) prohibit, so it should not be reused as written.

# Decisions and status
- Recommended order: OTTO cleanup first, then /plumbing/, Tempe, Queen Creek, Mesa (rewrite Chandler off its copy), Phoenix, Scottsdale.
- Per the Sep 3 to Oct 2 work summary, the 6 general plumbing city pages were redesigned with new titles and metas in the first post-launch week. Tempe's emergency-search problem stayed open into October (Keyword Targeting Audit).
